prompts.lantern-normal:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: production pixel-art NetHack environment source board. Edit the attached existing tileset source, preserving the EXACT 1536x1024 layout, room silhouette, camera, semi-isometric orthogonal grid, wall positions, wall heights, all characters, objects, and door locations. Change only wall and floor materials from an excavated mine to a natural Caveman quest cave. Remove all timber supports, metal bands, bolts, lamps, ore veins and glowing spots from walls and replace them with continuous natural stone. Keep the source board composition and wall extraction regions precisely unchanged: north wall y105-211, west wall x255-331, east wall x1211-1287, floor y211-578. No brick courses, no modern machinery, no new props or lighting. Broad fractured rock faces with readable dark crevices, restrained fine texture, crisp pixel edges matching original artwork. Floor should be quiet worn stone and packed earth, minimal small grit, keeping existing tile grid. Upper-left floor patch inside room must remain clear for tile extraction. Preserve doors, sprites and bottom panels exactly.
Color/material direction: warm weathered gray-brown limestone, modestly lighter than the mine, muted neutral earth floor; damp and ancient with no active fires. This is the ordinary cave variant, unpolished natural rock.
prompts.lantern-goal: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: this 1536x1024 Lantern natural cave source board. Change ONLY the natural wall surfaces into the Chromatic Dragon's ancient chamber: the same gray-brown limestone geometry, worn smoother and polished, with subtle dark soot/scorch streaks running across some broad surfaces. This is polished natural rock, NOT brickwork, not a palace, no masonry courses. Floor quieter worn stone and packed earth with slight soot patches, NO fire, lava, ice or bones. Preserve EXACT composition, room geometry, all wall positions, semi-isometric perspective, north wall y105-211, west x255-331, east x1211-1287, floor y211-578, and lower wall edge. Keep pixel-art style, overall stone lightness, sourceboard title/panels, all sprites, doors, props and positions unchanged. No supports, lamps, ore, glow or new objects. Scorching must be restrained and safe to repeat across tiles, not a large mural. Output1536x1024.
